programme.desc: Det dyker upp nya möjligheter när Abbi äntligen lyckas att träna någon på Soulstice och Ilana gör succé som företagshöjdare.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi måste dra ut sina visdomständer och Ilana ser det som sin plikt att sköta om henne tills hon mår bättre - vilket självklart innebär en massa 'medikamenter' och en påtaglig brist på tillsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi och Jeremy går på en dejt som slutar med en överraskning medan Ilana och hennes mamma letar överallt efter den perfekta handväskan.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Tjejerna letar efter den perfekta festen, vilket avslöjar en underlig och surrealistisk sida hos Abbi som bekräftar Ilanas värsta farhågor.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Gänget ska fira att Jaime blivit amerikansk medborgare men Bevers leder Abbi och Ilana på avvägar genom att lova dem gratissprit. Under tiden får Lincoln och Jaime klara sig själva bland alla advokater.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi ger sig av för att återfinna en försvunnen kappa medan Ilana utforskar en ny romans - som dock känns besynnerligt välbekant.

programme.title: Broad City: St. Mark's
programme.desc: När tjejerna firar Ilanas 23-årsdag blir de avbrutna av en tonåring på rymmen vilket leder till en vild jakt runt St. Mark's Place.

programme.title: Broad City: Two Chainz
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana får klädproblem på väg till en väninnas utställning samtidigt som de är i desperat behov av en offentlig toalett.

programme.title: Broad City: Co-Op

programme.title: Broad City: Game Over
programme.desc: Ilana får en ny chans hos Deals, Deals, Deals och Abbi försöker hålla sin tävlingsinriktade sida i schack när jobbet anordnar Soulstice Games.

programme.title: Broad City: Rat Pack
programme.desc: När Jaime och Ilana får en dyr räkning av skadedjursbekämparen bestämmer de sig för att ha en fest för att få in pengarna. Samtidigt så försöker Abbi att träffa nya människor.

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana hittar sitt nya kall samtidigt som Abbi står inför det mest fruktade stället i världen: Bilprovningen.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana åker till Philadelphia för att besöka Abbis hemstad. Men när Abbi inser att hon gjorde ett stort misstag i high school förvandlas det till att hon och Ilana måste göra botgöring.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana anmäler sina lägenheter till B&B-NYC för att få ihop lite extra stålar.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanas föräldrar kommer till stan för att fira sin bröllopsdag, men både Abbi och Ilana har svårt att fira eftersom de har problem i sina förhållanden.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana ska resa bort, men bara att ta sig till flygplatsen visar sig bli mycket svårare än vad de trodde.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
programme.desc: Abbi får plötsligt mens ombord på ett flygplan, så hon och Ilana gör allt för att få tag på en tampong.

programme.title: Broad City: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: En vårdag 2011 träffas Abbi och Ilana för första gången.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbis kortvariga återkomst till Soulstice blir intressant när hon får chansen hon alltid har drömt om. Ilana får nytt jobb på en restaurang.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana shoppar loss med sina servitrispengar, och Abbi njuter av ett nytt förhållande. Senare på kvällen träffar tjejerna en gammal kompis på en fest.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Guy blir ansvarig för Wolverine, där upplärningen av en ny arbetare hotar att stå i vägen för hans uppdrag att hitta säsongens första jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Precis när teamet på Wolverine skärper sina säkerhetsrutiner kollapsar den nya arbetaren Jay, vilket exponerar sprickorna i deras nödberedskap.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt i den nya grävmaskinen samtidigt som ett lager av värdelösa stenar gör att Claudia börjar överväga en ny gruvstrategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan tar med sig en grupp köpare till Jade City vilket skapar panikläge i Claudias team för att hitta säsongens första säljbara jadeblock.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Medan besättningen kämpar sig genom lera för att hitta ett stenblock som är värt en miljon dollar, riskerar Josh att förlora utrustning för halv miljon dollar när han försöker dra upp sin lastbil ur ett slukhål.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet hittar säsongens bästa jadeblock, men riskerar att minska dess värde när de försöker kapa bort alla frakturer.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias son Justin visar att han har en näsa för jade, medan Scrappy Larry, Robin och Josh kämpar för att bogsera sin trasiga lastbil upp från spåret till Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: En körning av tillhörigheter tvingar ut Robin och Justin på ett sista försök att leta efter jadestenar för att rädda säsongen medan Scrappy Larry har bråttom för att få en dieseltank ombyggd.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias satsning på att driva en arbetsgrupp i Jade City hotas när septiktanken backar in i deras dricksvatten.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Med tidig ankomst av det kalla vädret och med skulder som hopar sig, knuffar, släpar och skjuter besättningen på en maffig och potentiellt säsongsvinnande sten till lägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Med årets mest lovande stenblock under sågen på Wolverine, kör Josh och R2 i diket med sin lastbil, vilket även drabbar Claudia och teamet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Loppet pågår för att ta sig bort från Wolverine-lägret innan snön täcker allt.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia blir tvungen att köra stenbilen när hennes besättning kämpar sig uppför den steniga stigen till deras bergstoppsbelägna jadeläger, Wolverine

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningarna kulminerar när Claudia, Robin och teamet försöker transportera människor och utrustning till det avlägsna jadelägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia och Robin försöker imponera på sina nya affärspartners men de första dagarna på deras nya område, Bullion Creek, är krävande.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Säsongens första stora stenblock transporteras tillbaka till lägret och sätts under sågen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin skyndar sig för att inmuta ett område efter att han snubblat över ett fantastiskt jadefynd, men andra gruvarbetare närmar sig.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias nya partnerskap blir lidande när Justin och teamet distraheras av att försöka flytta ett gigantiskt stenblock som kan vara värt en förmögenhet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Efter att ha hamnat i konflikt med sina affärspartners, tävlar Claudia och Robin om att starta om gruvdriften vid Wolverine, men blir stoppade av ett överraskande hinder.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet kämpar för att få igång Dynastys jadebrott trots bristfällig utrustning.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin och Mike kämpar med frakturer och varandra och försöker bevisa sina metoder för otåliga investerare.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan återvänder från Kina och ger Justin och Mike en kalldusch av verklighet angående jaden som de håller på att bryta.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin och Mike kämpar sig genom snö och fruset vatten för att ta sig fram till det enda potentiellt väldigt värdefulla klippblocket med jade – Big Fin.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Vintern anländer till Dynasty och teamet kämpar med gruvbrytningen fram till allra sista minuten.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia finansierar själv sin stenbrottssäsong och bestämmer sig för att börja jakten på jade en månad tidigare och tvingas ompröva sin strategi när snö och högt vatten stoppar teamet i dess spår.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Robin följer sin intuition till en ny sida på ett gammalt bergsbruksområde, medan Joshs höga förväntningar och korta stubin frestar på Garys tålamod.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Guy kämpar med grävmaskinen för att blotta ett enormt fynd medan Joshs missnöje med sin position i teamet får familjekonflikter att koka över.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet står inför en farlig brytning på stränderna ovanför Turnagainfloden.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kapandet av ett potentiellt miljonfynd sätts på is när gammal utrustning går sönder.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kapandet börjar äntligen av den gigantiska jadeskivan vid Dynasty, men stora delar av skivan fraktureras.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Skyfall hotar besättningens säkerhet och stänger av gruvdriften vid grop 3. Josh får en chans att bevisa sina förmågor med grävmaskinen, men ett sammanbrott sätter hans tålamod på prov.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: När en viktig jadeköpare inte blir imponerad av skivan från grop 3, tvingas Claudia fatta ett svårt beslut som gör hennes besättning besviken.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kapploppet att hinna packa ihop lägret vid Wolverine blir en mardröm när värme, sjukdomar och en skogsbrand sänker sig över besättningen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Den brutala färden till en ny gruvplats leder till att familjen skiljs åt och driver Josh till bristningsgränsen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia är otålig inför att bryta mark på den nya platsen, men arbetet stoppas av en rad olyckliga incidenter i deras gamla gruvläger, Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Små lyxmoment i lägret muntrar upp en missnöjd besättning, och med överraskande besökare väcks Claudias hopp om sin framtid på Two Mile.

programme.title: Matlock: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is left with a lot of questions and no answers when his client, Drew Carey, bolts from the courtroom during a preliminary hearing for murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Buddies
programme.desc: A deathbed letter from an old friend puts the life of Ben Matlock in peril when he feels morally obligated to reopen a murder case more than three decades old.

programme.title: Matlock: The Scrooge
programme.desc: The senseless murder of a toy store owner not only clouds the Christmas spirit, but threatens an annual party and gifts of toys to local orphans.

programme.title: Matlock: The Student
programme.desc: A philandering college professor is murdered in his classroom and Marcy Hansen is the prime suspect, having announced her pregnancy in an argument before witnesses.

programme.title: Matlock: The Talk Show
programme.desc: Ben Matlock and Michelle Thomas are exposed to a quick course in trash television when a vicious talk show host, Don Galloway, humiliates three prominent women to boost his ratings.

programme.title: Matlock: The Victim
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is convinced that Alex Gordon, a paraplegic, murdered his wife and framed his business partner, Bret Howell, for the crime.

programme.title: Matlock: The Kidnapper
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is kidnapped and threatened by an unknown person, or persons, who may be seeking revenge for sending them to prison.

programme.title: Matlock: The Informer (Part 1)
programme.desc: Ben Matlock becomes involved in a mob blackmail scheme when he defends a famous criminal lawyer, David O’Malley, accused of murdering an underworld kingpin.

programme.title: Matlock: The Informer (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock must pull out all the stops to keep his client, David O’Malley, a famed criminal lawyer in his own right, in line, and the jury on his side. Meanwhile, Conrad races against time to track down an informer that will crack the case.

programme.title: Matlock: The D.A.
programme.desc: Julie March is terrified by a mysterious man following a lurid murder trial. Publicly threatened by the convicted man’s brother, Rick Biloit, Julie reluctantly accepts Ben Matlock’s offer to become his houseguest until she is out of harm’s way.

programme.title: Matlock: The Blackmailer
programme.desc: Political cartoonist Ronald Winfield is murdered when he exposes a Senator’s infidelity through his comic strip.

programme.title: Matlock: The Cookie Monster
programme.desc: Ben Matlock investigates when a friend, Bobby Neil, is accused of murdering a cookie queen who was out to crumble her competitors with a hostile takeover.

programme.title: Matlock: Nowhere To Turn (Part 1)
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is in a lousy mood. He took a crowded red-eye flight to Los Angeles, arrived on a foggy morning and, before sunset, he was mugged, drugged, jailed for contempt of court, robbed, accused of murder.

programme.title: Matlock: Nowhere To Turn (Part 2)
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is in a lousy mood. He took a crowded red-eye flight to Los Angeles, arrived on a foggy morning and, before sunset, he was mugged, drugged, jailed for contempt of court, robbed, accused of murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Mother
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is confronted with a dilemma. He knows his client, Phyllis Todd, is innocent of murder, but he strongly suspects she has allowed herself to be accused of the crime to protect her daughter.

programme.title: Matlock: The Madam
programme.desc: Albeit with some reluctance, Ben Matlock defends one of Atlanta’s most successful madams, Ann Rawls, when she is accused of murdering one of her working girls.

programme.title: Matlock: The Personal Trainer
programme.desc: Ben Matlock discovers the private life of a personal trainer includes sizzling secrets that might shatter the reputations of several socialites. Harry Slade puts Casanova to shame, but it costs him his life.

programme.title: Matlock: The Narc
programme.desc: Ben Matlock exposes skimming and corruption when he defends undercover narcotics officer Johnny Bauer against murder charges.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Red Sun Rampant
programme.desc: Japan attacks the USA on 7 Dec 1941. For the next 6 months, they continue to have successful attacks.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Mediterranean and North Africa
programme.desc: Italy's failed attacks in the Mediterranean region draw in the Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The remaining five contestants fly to Toronto, where they take on the CN Tower's EdgeWalk before moving into their home at the SoHo Metropolitan Hotel.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: Star of The Hills and America's Next Top Model judge Kelly Cutrone gives the contenders a grilling in Toronto ahead of next week's final.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: Dannii Minogue joins host Elle Macpherson and Tyson Beckford as 28 hopefuls begin their battle for a modelling contract with a leading agency. The girls pull out all the stops but only half of them will survive the cull.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 2
programme.desc: The contestants head to the National Wedding Show at Birmingham's NEC to be coached in the art of the catwalk by model Jade Parfitt.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 3
programme.desc: It's time for the contestants to receive their makeovers and host Elle Macpherson embraces the challenge by opting for a new look herself. After their transformations, the girls pose like professional gymnasts with Olympian Louis Smith.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: Chemistry with the camera is imperative for a top model, so to separate the sizzlers from the fizzlers, the girls must pose with male models.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson shares her top tips in a modelling workshop before Tyson challenges the girls to shine on a shoot in an ex-coal mine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 8
programme.desc: Journalist Hilary Alexander quizzes the would-be catwalk stars on the industry they are so eager to become part of. The winners are treated to a party with former contestants including last year's winner Letitia Herod.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson enrols the seven remaining contestants in a Fashion Targets Breast Cancer catwalk event for their biggest showcase yet and they also take part in a beauty shoot with a cosmetics company.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Based on the hit US reality show America's Next Top Model this UK version presented by Lisa Snowdon follows the latest group of hopefuls through their journey to becoming Britain's newest 'Top Model'.

programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex iscensätter en dramatisk räddning i Moldavien. Jeff upptäcker en ledtråd till Fallons vistelseort. Little Blake inser att Rita inte är Krystle och Dominique ringer ett mystiskt samtal från utlandet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter att ha kommit i säkerhet läggs den förlamade kung Galen in på sjukhus. Joel utger sig för att vara läkare för att få tillträde till herrgården. Galen ger Alexis ett kraftfullt löfte från sin sjukhussäng.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sammy Jo får panik när Blake eventuellt upptäcker att Krystle är i fångenskap. Claudia planerar tillsammans med Adam att få tillbaka sin oljekälla. Galen lovar att göra Alexis till en kraftfull kvinna när han försöker återta tronen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Rita fruktar att bli upptäckt när Blake bokar in ett möte för henne med sin läkare. Galen fortsätter sina intriger för att återta tronen. Michael bestämmer sig enbart för att han och Amanda ska bilda familj.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Joel säger till Rita att hon måste ligga med Blake. Joel och den riktiga Krystle ses tillsammans på en rastgård. Galen skickar Michael till New York för att få hjälp.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: När Blake hotar med skilsmässa vidtar Rita drastiska åtgärder. Galen döljer sitt tillfrisknande när han planerar att återta tronen. Jonathan accepterar en tjänst hos Bart Fallmont.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake får den dödliga dosen gift. Sammy Jo upptäcker en misstänkt flaska. Krystle försöker fly på två bedrägliga sätt. Ett knytnävsslagsmål bryter ut om rörledningen. Dex kämpar för byggrättigheter.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Galen planerar sin comeback. Alexis förlorade syster dyker upp. Joel och Rita planerar sitt sista drag. Blakes liv är i fara.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter att ha fallit ner för trappan måste Blake föras till sjukhus. Adam inser att han är utskriven ur sin fars testamente och försöker desperat övertyga en knappt vid medvetande Blake att skriva under ett nytt dokument.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle utger sig för att vara Rita och flyr. Joel och Rita störtar över en klippa. Alexis planerar Krystles död. Dex konfronterar Galen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: En förtalande reporter orsakar Krystles känslomässiga sammanbrott. Fallon återvänder hem och döljer en oroande hemlighet. Amanda bestämmer sig för att skilja sig från Michael.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis hittar Amanda och Dex i sängen tillsammans. Krystle vänder på steken mot Alexis. Adam undersöker Bart Fallmonts förflutna.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blakes jakt på Rita och Joel intensifieras. Alexis driver Dex och Amanda tillbaka till varandra medan Blake försöker separera de två. Adam hotar att avslöja Barts hemlighet. Caress gör ett besök hos Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle och Alexis bråkar om Blake. Bart uttrycker sina sanna känslor för Steven medan en privatdetektiv avslöjar Barts tidigare kärleksaffärer. Garretts misstankar om Jackies far växer.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis tar med sig Ben Carrington till maskeradbalen. Adams plan att utpressa Bart Fallmont förverkligas. Garrett konfronterar Dominique med sina misstankar om att Jackie är hans dotter.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Barts hemliga förflutna ger triumf för Denver-Carrington, men Blake står inför ett möjligt nederlag i rättssalen i striden med sin bror Ben. Dex avvisar Amandas känslor.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Jackie upptäcker att hennes far står som "okänd" på hennes födelseattest. Alexis köper företaget som planerar att ge ut Caress bok.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blakes förhoppningar om seger krossas av ett berusat vittne. Bart blir avstängd som senatorskandidat. Kvinnan som kan rentvå Blakes namn tvingas dölja sin identitet.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle works with Tom in order to get close to Jordan. Shawn recruits a small band of promicin positives to break Kevin out of Promise City. Tom and Diana face off in the backroom of a grocery store, and Diana is forced to shoot Tom.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A school teacher terrifies parents with her ability to inspire talents within students. Meanwhile, Richard and Lily are confronted by police, and Jordan warns Shawn not to overuse his healing gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Edwin Mayuya, a 4400 who has the ability is to heal damaged fetal chromosomes while in utero. Unfortunately, it turns out this man is responsible for the slaughter of an entire clinic.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC follows a series of clues that lead them to Jordan Collier's killer. Tom faces a difficult choice when he must choose between the law or his family.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: 4400s across the world are coming down with strange and life threatening illnesses. Tom and Diana learn a horrible secret that the government may have directly caused the illnesses of the 4400s.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: Troll

programme.title: Kill, Baby Kill!

programme.title: The Cat o' Nine Tails
programme.desc: En reporter slår sig ihop med en blind korsordskonstruktör för att utreda en rad mord kopplade till ett skuggigt läkemedelsbolags hemliga genexperiment. När sanningen närmar sig blir de själva mördarens nästa mål.

programme.title: The Terror
programme.desc: A French lieutenant is separated from his unit and awakens to the sight of a beautiful woman. He seeks refuge in an eerie castle inhabited by a reclusive baron and seeks the whereabouts of the woman, only to learn that she is the baron's late wife.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Claw of Shame
programme.desc: I det här specialavsnittet utför Nathan en vågad flykt där han riskerar ett öde värre än döden, och säsongens misslyckade affärsidéer presenteras.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Haunted House / The Hunk
programme.desc: Nathan försöker hjälpa ett spökhus som har problem. Han försöker också övervinna sin rädsla för det motsatta könet genom att dejta tio kvinnor samtidigt.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Richards Tip
programme.desc: Nathan hjälper en småstadskrog genom en extremt generös handling.

programme.desc: Nathan upptäcker att tomten han brukar hjälpa har en mörk hemlighet. Han försöker marknadsföra en djurpark, med oväntade resultat. Dessutom ertappas en tonåring med att måla graffiti.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Dumb Starbucks
programme.desc: Nathan använder parodi för att hjälpa ett kafé som har det svårt.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Finding Frances Part 1

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.sub-title: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lethe-bankerne
programme.desc: Et sort hul giver Dylan mulighed for at kommunikere med sin tidligere forlovede 300 år tilbage i tiden.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken
programme.desc: Dylan er fængslet på en fængselsplanet og må arrangere en flugt, mens hans besætning forsøger at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hele Neptuns store hav
programme.desc: Castalianere går om bord på Andromeda for at færdiggøre charteret for det nye Commonwealth. Da lederen bliver fundet død, er Tyr den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Perlerne, der var hans øjne
programme.desc: Beka finder ud af, at hendes fars tidligere forretningspartner handler med et stærkt vanedannende stof kaldet F lash

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårernes matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda opdager sit søsterskib, Pax Magellanic. Besætningen om bord på Pax er 300 år gammel... men er ikke blevet ældre en eneste dag.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik fra en fjern tromme
programme.desc: Tyr nødlander Eureka Maru på en nietzscheansk planet og får hukommelsestab. Han skal huske, hvad han laver, før nietzscheanerne opdager ham og hans kasse med stjålne varer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper modtager viden fra en døende Perseid, men opdager først, at Perseid blev eftersøgt af en dusørjæger, som nu har rettet sin opmærksomhed mod Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan bliver arresteret for at have myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summen af dens dele
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver bordet af en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfund. Ibegyndelsen er dronen venlig, men den forsøger at tvinge skibet til at slutte sig til Consensus.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frygt og afsky i Mælkevejen
programme.desc: Gerentex er tilbage, og han kræver, at Trance og Harper hjælper ham med sin nye plan: at finde Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djævelen tager det længste strå
programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honningtilbuddet
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at skabe fred mellem to forskellige nietzscheanske stoltheder ved at eskortere prinsessen fra det ene sted til hendes arrangerede ægteskab med prinsen fra det andet sted.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjernekrydsede
programme.desc: Rommies avatar bliver forelsket i det, der viser sig at være avataren af et krigsskib ved navn Gabriel. Gabriel forsøger at inficere Rommie med en virus, der sender sine planer til krigsskibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det er et dejligt lys
programme.desc: Beka tager Andromeda med til Tarn-Vedra, men længere tid i slipstrømmen giver bivirkninger. For at bekæmpe dem begynder Beka at tage Flash og bliver snart afhængig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie skal redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdenskib.

programme.title: Andromeda: Exitstrategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev og Tyr styrter ned efter at være undsluppet en bande nietzscheanere, men står snart over for en ny trussel: Rev's behov for at spise.

programme.title: Andromeda: Et hjerte for falskhed indrammet
programme.desc: Besætningen skal stjæle en juvel, som er centrum for en fejde mellem en driftsejer og Than. Beka falder for en sikkerhedschef, som tidligere var tyv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Månestenen
programme.desc: Henry kommer i vanskeligheder hjemme, da en sten fra det ydre rum viser sig, at være mere end først antaget.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Faldne Fødselsdagspige.
programme.desc: Henry bliver ikke inviteret til en fødselsdagsfest, fordi han bliver beskyldt for at have skubbet fødselaren ud fra hendes tag det foregående år. Kaptajn Mand træder til for at rense Henrys navn.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Lidt for God Spiller
programme.desc: Den nye elev, Shawn, tager Henrys plads på basketholdet, selvom Henry mistænker ham for at være noget ældre, end han påstår. Kaptajn Mand må overkomme gamle uoverensstemmelser for at få hjælp af en ven. Gæstestjerne: Russel Westbrook.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry Menneskebæst
programme.desc: Henry har en vigtig date, men tingene går ikke helt som planlagt, da han ved et uheld kommer i kontakt med en sær maskine i Mandehulen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Usynlige Brad
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mands ven Brad, der ved et uheld for flere år siden blev usynlig, kommer på besøg. Der går ikke længe før alle er blevet trætte af ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Afsløreren
programme.desc: Henry og Ray forsøger at stoppe en yderst irriterende forbryder, der kalder sig for Afsløreren. Piper når grænsen, i forsøget på at komme med i en utroligt populær Kaptajn Mand fanklub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Præmietyveri
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand får Henry med i hans yndlings gameshow, Spin og Vind, i forsøget på at nå til bunds i en række forbrydelser. Men Henry ender med selv at blive offer for den samme slags forbrydelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Supervulkanen
programme.desc: Da en supervulkan under Swellview ser ud til at kunne gå i udbrud, bliver Henry og Ray overbeviste om, at Verden snart går under. Piper er overbevist om at hun har glutenallergi.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vold & Valentinsdag
programme.desc: Da pigen Henry er vild med, tager på date med en anden fyr på Valentinsdag, bygger Schwoz en androide, der kan hjælpe Henry med at gøre pigen jaloux. Ray tager på en ubehagelig date med en af Henrys lærere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fanget i Kælderen
programme.desc: Henry, Charlotte og Rays sjove planer bliver aflyst, da Jasper kommer til at aktivere nød-nedlukningen i Skidt og Kanel.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Elevatorkysset
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen redder Bianca ender de med at kysse. Henry har det fint med det, indtil han indser at Bianca kyssede Faredrengen - og ikke Henry. Det mener Henry er det samme som at have været ham utro.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Manden i huset
programme.desc: Da Henrys mor får sin pung stjålet, beslutter Kaptajn Mand sig for at flytte hjem til Henrys familie, for at beskytte dem. Men Kaptajn Mand tager rollen som manden i huset lidt for alvorligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømmefangerne
programme.desc: En skurks drømmestråle rammer Henry og spærrer ham inde i en drømmetilstand, som kun Charlotte kan redde ham ud fra.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Superhelt i Stuearrest
programme.desc: Da Henry bliver taget i at snige sig ud om aftenen, får han stuearrest. Charlotte overtager hans rolle som Kaptajn Mands makker og Piper gør hvad hun kan for at drive Henry til vanvid hjemme i huset.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Klovn
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand forsøger at forbedre sit omdømme, ved at afholde en konkurrence, hvor man kan vinde en rundvisning af den hemmelige hule. Da vinderne bliver nogle af Henrys venner, bliver han bekymret for om hans identitet kan blive afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Spandefælden
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte vil gerne fortælle Jasper, at Henry i virkeligheden er Faredrengen. De beslutter sig derfor for, at finde ud af om Jasper er klar til at få det at vide.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1
programme.desc: En gruppe grafittimalere overdænger Swellview med grafittitegninger. Og imens de forsøger at finde gruppens leder, bliver Faredrengen fristet af en sød pige i gruppen, der tvinger ham til at vælge imellem pigen og Kaptajn Mand.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2
programme.desc: Faredrengen er gået med i grafittibanden, der spraymaler overalt i Swellview. Kaptajn Mand forsøger desperat at finde Faredrengen og Van, der er leder af gruppen.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kæreste
programme.desc: Jaspers kæreste fra sommerlejren er kommet for at besøge ham, og hun bor hos Charlotte. Men kæresten bliver jaloux, og tror at Charlotte er forelsket i Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rytmerne Fortsætter
programme.desc: Da Dr. Minyak vender tilbage, er Henry pludselig i fare, da den ondskabsfulde doktor har lavet hans bedste ven Charlotte om til en super stærk skabning, der skal fange Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del
programme.desc: Henry forsøger at fange Den Gale Bedste - en gammel bedstemor, der bliver ved med at terrorisere Kaptajn Mand i offentligheden. Det giver Henry udfordringer på både arbejds- og kærlighedsfronten.
programme.sub-title: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del
programme.desc: Henrys planer for Frikadelle-festen på Swellview Junior High School er komplicerede, da han bliver nødt til også at møde op som Faredrengen. Under festen sker der ting, der gør, at han må træffe en dramatisk beslutning.
programme.sub-title: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og Sortspætterne
programme.desc: Da Pipers basketballtræner stopper, træder Henry til som træner for Pipers hold i stedet. Han forsøger at piske holdet i form, men møder udfordringer fra idrætskomitéen og deres utraditionelle regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mand: på Ferie
programme.desc: Ray har givet Henry og Charlotte ansvar for Swellview, mens han er bortrejst i forbindelse med sin fætters bryllup. Der opstår problemer, da de skal klare tingene på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Hemmelige Bøf
programme.desc: Henry har fået en invitation til Swellviews mest eksklusive restaurant og beslutter at invitere hans chef, Ray, med. Men tingene blive mere komplicerede end han regnede med.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Misundelige Henry
programme.desc: Efter at Jasper bliver rost som byens helt, bliver Henry jaloux over, at det altid er Faredrengen der får al anerkendelsen, mens han ikke selv får noget som helst.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Julefaren
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand må tilbringe julen i fængsel, da han er blevet arresteret for en mindre forbrydelse. Henry og Charlotte må hjælpe ham med at bevare julestemningen bag tremmer.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uforgængelige Henry - 1. del
programme.desc: Henry beslutter sig for at blive usårlig ligesom Kaptajn Mand. Men tingene går ikke lige, som Henry har planlagt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uforgængelige Henry - 2. del
programme.desc: Henry beslutter sig for at blive usårlig ligesom Kaptajn Mand. Men tingene går ikke lige, som Henry har planlagt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: SMS, Løgne og Video
programme.desc: Da en video af Henry og Rays transformation til Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand slipper ud, må Henry gå til ekstremer for at holde sin hemmelighed hemmelig.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Det Omvendte Univers
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte transporteres under en storm til et parallelt univers, hvor Ray og Schwoz er onde og vil Piper til livs. Onde Ray og Onde Schwoz skal standses, og Henry og Charlotte skal tilbage til deres eget univers.

programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within a Hair
programme.desc: In 1996, Indiana police identified Richard Alexander as the “River Park Rapist” who assaulted four women that year. Later, DNA analysis casts doubt on his conviction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dew Process
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open and reveal the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: On a windy Kansas night in 1995, a mysterious fire swept through the home of a prominent doctor. In the debris, investigators found evidence which told them how the fire started.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her infant son, the obvious suspect is the husband and father of the victims. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story of passion gone wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Bond
programme.desc: Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: Mark Fair left for work and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead. During the autopsy, bite marks on her body were re-examined and forensic odontology identified the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well-liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Safe Place
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Ambition
programme.desc: When a policeman's house goes up in flames, experts suspect arson. The officer whose home was torched arrests low-level drug dealer James Wren, who confesses. But when the suspect vanishes, investigators question the authenticity of the confession.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.
